useful: overview: exposed the 2018-10..2020-03 split between directions and the Feb 2013 surge at a glance
zeros(counter=True): listed the early-life daytime dropouts and the week-long outages
directions(by='day'): a_covers_b of 0.97-1.0 pinned the Feb 2013 double-counting of 68 into 67 to exact days
network: confirmed the week-long zero spells were feed-wide
doubled: found the single doubled day 2022-02-19
compare: showed the March 2014 collapse was specific to this site
weather: separated storm zeros from dry-day faults
not_useful: duplicates: single-channel counter, nothing to find
spikes: only isolated one-slot bursts of 20-39, plausibly real groups
improve: zeros: add rain_mm and a weekday flag so dry-weekday dropouts stand out without a separate join
hourly: an option to return per-day hourly vectors would save hand-rolled pivots
add: a per-day AM/PM peak table per direction (bikes in 06-09 and 16-19) with a ratio to the direction's recent median, to date partial sensor failures like direction 67 in 2018-2020

summary: A single Metrocount piezo on the Iron Cove Bridge path, mostly sound but with early-life (2012-13) daytime dropouts, a two-week spell in Feb 2013 where direction 67 also counted 68's riders, feed-wide week-long outages, and a doubled day on 2022-02-19. Direction 67 failed intermittently from Oct 2018 to the March 2020 gap, losing most of its citybound AM peak, so it is set missing except a partly recovered spell in mid-2019 flagged uncertain. The March-April 2014 collapse in both directions may be a closure or a fault and is left uncertain; no series definitions are needed.
